questReqs.text: Ores required depend on your mining level. Tin: 1-10, Coal: 11-54, Mithril: 55+.

steps.title: Starting out
steps.text: Right click and talk to Mord Gunnars on the northern Rellekka dock about Jatizso's history.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: Can you ferry me to Jatizso?

steps.title: Send in the clowns
steps.text: Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building with tiled floors.

postconditions.text: you can buy some from my fishmonger

steps.text:
Talk to the king with a raw tuna.
  • Can be obtained from the cage/harpoon fishing spots to the south.

Talk to the King again, then give him your ores.
  • There is a mine down the stairs to the north-west if you didn't bring them.
Open the chest (behind the throne) and take the silly jester outfit.

actions.text: Take the jester's hat.
Take the jester's top.
Take the jester's tights.

steps.title: Clowning around
steps.text: Equip the silly jester outfit, with nothing in your hands, and talk to Slug Hemligssen, north of the bank.

actions.text: Free stuff please.
I am ready.

postconditions.text: will make sure the King is informed

steps.text: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar, south of the bank.
steps.warning: Dismiss any Summoning familiars and pets.

Kill 8 yaks for their hair, and pick up 3 yak hides too.

steps.title: Regicide
steps.text:
Prepare for battle. Once you're ready, move to the next step manually.
  • It's recommended to wear the Yak-hide armour and Fremennik round shield, and prioritise high range defence.
  • It is not advised to kill the boss with ranged weapons.
Enter the Ice Troll Caves to the far east of the northern-most island.

Kill 10 ice trolls.
  • Optional: Talk to Bork for food, strength potions, and prayer potions.
steps.warning: Farcasting the ones on the east does not count.

postconditions.text: You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King

steps.text: Kill and then decapitate the Ice Troll King.
Take the head to Mawnis Burowgar.
